units.rawText: If it was my fault, then I apologize. But if you overstepped the regulations and moved props or Dolls of your own volition, then please spare me your lamentations.
units.displayText: If it was my fault, then I apologize. But if you overstepped the regulations and moved props or Dolls of your own volition, then please spare me your lamentations.

spans.text: If it was my fault, then I apologize. But if you overstepped the regulations and moved props or Dolls of your own volition, then please spare me your lamentations.

units.rawText: You—you dare to point fingers at me? If it wasn't for you, I'd still be on the stage, and not slaving away here! Do you think I wouldn't—
units.displayText: You—you dare to point fingers at me? If it wasn't for you, I'd still be on the stage, and not slaving away here! Do you think I wouldn't—

spans.text: You—you dare to point fingers at me? If it wasn't for you, I'd still be on the stage, and not slaving away here! Do you think I wouldn't—

units.rawText: <size=28>Alright, enough of that. Those toys are for the posh people, and are you able to pay for it if something was to break?</size>
units.displayText: Alright, enough of that. Those toys are for the posh people, and are you able to pay for it if something was to break?

units.rawText: Besides, there's CCTV backstage here, so be careful... Remember what we had to go through to stay here.
units.displayText: Besides, there's CCTV backstage here, so be careful... Remember what we had to go through to stay here.

spans.text: Besides, there's CCTV backstage here, so be careful... Remember what we had to go through to stay here.

units.rawText: At his companion's behest, the man's fury turns into a certain type of haggardness.
units.displayText: At his companion's behest, the man's fury turns into a certain type of haggardness.

spans.text: At his companion's behest, the man's fury turns into a certain type of haggardness.

units.rawText: Hmph! Not like these things' good days will go on for long... The people up there know that these pieces of scrap aren't anything compared to humans.
units.displayText: Hmph! Not like these things' good days will go on for long... The people up there know that these pieces of scrap aren't anything compared to humans.

spans.text: Hmph! Not like these things' good days will go on for long... The people up there know that these pieces of scrap aren't anything compared to humans.

units.rawText: <size=28>They're just fads like us, thrown away when the novelty wears off. Come on, there's more work to do for the next show.</size>

spans.text: They're just fads like us, thrown away when the novelty wears off. Come on, there's more work to do for the next show.

units.displayText: ...Piece of high-and-mighty trash!

spans.text: ...Piece of high-and-mighty trash!

units.rawText: Yes.

units.rawText: Distinguished guests, next is the long-awaited Doll performance! The featured Doll in this performance is the Royal Edition of the E-Orchestra series, which once served as an honor guard of foreign royalty!

units.rawText: Here is their spectacular performance, please do enjoy!

spans.text: Here is their spectacular performance, please do enjoy!

units.rawText: As the host finishes their introduction, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra made their way on stage with confident strides and heads held high, displaying the grandeur of a royal cohort for all to see.
units.displayText: As the host finishes their introduction, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra made their way on stage with confident strides and heads held high, displaying the grandeur of a royal cohort for all to see.

spans.text: As the host finishes their introduction, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra made their way on stage with confident strides and heads held high, displaying the grandeur of a royal cohort for all to see.

units.rawText: With steps taken as one, synchronized to the same beat and accompanied by a roaring melody, they exhibit the fruits borne by the sacrifice of basic functions and specialization of modules to the extreme—a sense of sublime dignity.
units.displayText: With steps taken as one, synchronized to the same beat and accompanied by a roaring melody, they exhibit the fruits borne by the sacrifice of basic functions and specialization of modules to the extreme—a sense of sublime dignity.

spans.text: With steps taken as one, synchronized to the same beat and accompanied by a roaring melody, they exhibit the fruits borne by the sacrifice of basic functions and specialization of modules to the extreme—a sense of sublime dignity.

units.rawText: As they suffer scorn, they continue in their impervious ways; as they endure torment, their spirits radiate; as they bear pain, their sights still rest on the horizon.
units.displayText: As they suffer scorn, they continue in their impervious ways; as they endure torment, their spirits radiate; as they bear pain, their sights still rest on the horizon.

spans.text: As they suffer scorn, they continue in their impervious ways; as they endure torment, their spirits radiate; as they bear pain, their sights still rest on the horizon.

units.rawText: With sights cast into the distance, head up, chest out, the Ceremonial Orchestra leaves the stage awash with applause, each and every sound pounding away at their neural clouds. Beneath her calm and proud exterior, Undine takes in each and every appraisal from her audience and host.

units.rawText: There more spectacular displays, so please look forward to it! Our next performance will be in half an hour—

units.rawText: Not bad, not bad at all. It seems to be something with quite the history. I thought it was all empty talk, but it looks as though they'll be able to back it up.
units.displayText: Not bad, not bad at all. It seems to be something with quite the history. I thought it was all empty talk, but it looks as though they'll be able to back it up.

spans.text: See, like I said, the general manager's always got a good eye!

units.rawText: Haha, you flatter me, but these things are far from the best there is to offer.
units.displayText: Haha, you flatter me, but these things are far from the best there is to offer.

spans.text: Haha, you flatter me, but these things are far from the best there is to offer.

units.rawText: You're far too humble, Manager. Your arrangements are nothing but the finest!

units.rawText: How unprofessional, there's nothing ceremonial in you whatsoever. You can't even learn properly without me. I've taken no shortage of scolding because of your shortcomings.

units.rawText: And what are you mumbling about, you lot? If you had that effort to spare, then save it for your performances. Stupid and obstructive, who knows what the designer was thinking, giving you those pieces of scrap next to you.

units.rawText: I'm the only person good to you. If it were anyone else in charge, you'd be on your way to the scrapyard already.
units.displayText: I'm the only person good to you. If it were anyone else in charge, you'd be on your way to the scrapyard already.
